children: According to Wallstreetcn, a U.S. judge on September 4 extended the restriction on new mail voting rules for the U.S. government, after Boston federal district judge Indira Talwani issued a 14-day temporary restraining order on August 27 night that paused the U.S. Postal Service from enforcing the rules and set a hearing for September 3 on whether to impose a longer-term injunction. The U.S. government appealed on August 28.

title: U.S. Judge Extends Block on New Mail Voting Rules
